audit_comment: THE MM2 LETTER S WALK - the sandling p. 106, the scorpion variant table p. 107 (the large and huge columns), the scum creeper and the selkie p. 107, the shade p. 108, the greater shedu head p. 109 (prior-owned - the MM1 print owns it, head pins only, no def), the sirine and the skeleton (animal) p. 109, the skunk, the slime creature and the olive slime p. 110, the snake variant table p. 111 (the constrictor and poisonous columns), the solar pp. 111-112, the solifugid variant table p. 112 (the large, huge and giant columns), the spectator pp. 112-113, the spider (giant marine), the spriggan and the squealer pp. 113-114, the squirrel variant table p. 114 (the giant black and ordinary columns), the squirrel (carnivorous flying) p. 114, the stegocentipede pp. 114-115, the stench kow, the stone guardian and the storoper pp. 115-116, the sundew (giant), the swan and the swanmay pp. 116-117, the swordfish and the taer p. 117; the S-FLIP round: the Letter S gap box flips to closed (24 closed, 13 open). THIRTY-THREE .lua defs ride the R791 data_files extension, registry 733 -> 766; TWENTY-NINE entry heads carrying THIRTY-FOUR stat blocks, one prior-owned head (the greater shedu), no doctrine-only heads. THE SETTLED READS (capture primary, the 1eonline transcription the cross-check voice): the scum creeper, skunk, ordinary squirrel, carnivorous flying squirrel and solar the flat-hp path (hdNum 0, the ikiryo/obliviax precedent); the shade the nil block (the phantom precedent - the As-original-creature cells, AC the 9 default, xp 0); the solar 177 hp with the X/95000+35 xpValue 101195 and the AC 9 kept per print-wins against the transcription -9 (the capture preserves minus signs elsewhere - the R810 pudding precedent); the scorpion large sting damage 1-16 (the capture 1 the column clip, the transcription the confirm); the solifugid giant V350 the OCR artifact read V/350+8; the sirine 20%-or-more MR 20 and 3-or-less AC 3; the spectator body-4-eyes-7 AC 4 and the 4' diameter size (the capture 4" the prime artifact); the stegocentipede 3/6 AC 3 and the 1-and-1 attack sum 2; the taer 11-30 no-appearing confirmed in both voices; the selkie sealware the sealwere settle and the solar Drawnij the Drawmij settle; the olive slime 0 attacks the loader 1 clamp; every Standard/See-below/Variable magic resistance 0; the percent lair cells the bare-numeral read (the R812 repair lesson). Repair of the first cut: the double commas in the kS/kSMark array lines of the walk patch were collapsed to single commas (builder join bug); no other byte changed.

tables.audit_comment: THE S-GRID: the 33-row SStats stat grid (every armor class, hit-dice, bonus, avgHp, attack, xp, xp/hp, lair, move and magic-resistance cell of the thirty-three promoted letter S stat blocks, in print order - the sandling p. 106 through the taer p. 117)
col_comments: The armor class cells (the sirine 3 or less reads 3, the spectator Body 4, eyes 7 reads 4, the spriggan 3 (5) and the stegocentipede 3/6 read the first int, the shade As original creature the 9 default, the solar 9 kept per print-wins against the transcription -9)

The hit dice num cells (the scum creeper, skunk, ordinary squirrel, carnivorous flying squirrel and solar ride the flat-hp path - hdNum 0, avgHp the print hp; the skeleton animal 1-1 reads 1 die; the sirine 4-7, the spriggan 4 (8+4), the slime creature 3+2-of-3+2-5+2-or-8+2 and the swordfish 1+1-of-1+1-2+2-or-3+3 read the first number)
The hit dice bonus cells (the skeleton animal 1-1 reads -1 - the buckawn precedent; the taer 3+6 reads +6)

The avgHp cells (the floor(3.5 x hd + bonus) formula; the flat-hp reads carry the print hp: the scum creeper 5, the skunk 2, the ordinary squirrel 1, the carnivorous flying squirrel 4, the solar 177; the shade the nil block 0)

The attack cells (the loader semantics: the olive slime 0 clamps to 1, the sundew Special and the swanmay As swan or human floor at 1, the solifugid 2 or 1 and the taer 3 or 1 read the max, the stegocentipede 1 and 1 sums 2)
The xp base cells (the shade, ordinary squirrel, swan and swanmay read 0 - the phantom precedent)
The xp per hit point cells (the solar 35 the highest per-hp rate in the registry)

The in-lair percentage cells (the loader luaGetInt accepts only lua_isnumber strings, so the print percent cells ride as the bare-numeral read - the R812 repair lesson; the selkie 0 or 90% and the shade Variable read 0)
The move cells (the parseIntRange first-read: the sirine 12"//24" and the selkie 12"//36" read 12, the swan 3"/18" 3, the swordfish //24" 24, the squealer 12" @ 9" 12, the olive slime 0" 0)
The magic resistance cells (the sirine 20% or more reads 20, the spectator 5% and the solar 85% their percents, the swanmay 2% per hit die 2, every Standard/See below/Variable cell 0)
